Heavily increasing the basic... B. Requesting an extension for... C. Having been heavily increased... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentence: 'Requesting an extension for project commissioning, domestic solar power developers cited the increased customs duty.' Starter A aur C galat hain kyunki 'developers' ne na toh duty increase ki (A), aur na hi developers increase huye (C).
trick: Starter A active verb 'increasing' use kar raha hai, jabki developers ne badhaya nahi, sarkar ne badhaya. Starter C passive hai, developers khud badhe nahi. Dono reject.
tip: Active/Passive voice check karna MCQ solve karne ka pehla step hai.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. The ruling coalition lost the crucial vote of confidence in the assembly. || II. The chief minister submitted his resignation to the governor. || Starters: A. Losing the crucial vote... B. Having lost the crucial... C. Submitting his resignation to... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Losing the crucial vote of confidence, the chief minister submitted his resignation.' 2) 'Having lost the crucial vote, the chief minister submitted his resignation.' 3) 'Submitting his resignation, the chief minister accepted the lost vote of confidence.' Chief Minister is the leader of the ruling coalition, so modifying him with coalition's actions is logically acceptable here.
trick: Yahan 'coalition' aur 'chief minister' essentially ek hi doer ko represent karte hain, isliye participles naturally cross-apply ho jate hain bina dangling error ke.
tip: Synonymous entities ('team' and 'captain') same modifier le sakte hain.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. Witnessing a sharp decline... C. Due to the continuous hike... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Witnessing a sharp decline in new registrations, the affordable housing sector suffered due to costlier loans.' 2) 'Due to the continuous hike in the repo rate, the affordable housing sector witnessed a sharp decline.' Starter A galat hai kyunki 'housing sector' ne home loans ko costly nahi banaya.
trick: Starter A se start karein toh matlab hoga ki 'housing sector' loans costly kar raha hai, jabki ye RBI/repo rate ka kaam hai. Isliye A wrong hai.
tip: V-ing modifier main subject ko hamesha action ka performer bana deta hai.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. A series of battery fire incidents tarnished the reputation of electric scooters. || II. The road transport ministry ordered a comprehensive safety probe. || Starters: A. Tarnishing the reputation of... B. Ordering a comprehensive safety... C. Following a series of... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Ordering a comprehensive safety probe, the road transport ministry reacted to the battery fires.' 2) 'Following a series of battery fire incidents, the road transport ministry ordered a safety probe.' Starter A galat hai kyunki 'ministry' ne reputation kharab (tarnish) nahi ki, fires ne ki thi.
trick: Sentence ki shuruaat mein 'Tarnishing' lagane se agla shabd 'ministry' aayega, jiska matlan hoga ministry badnam kar rahi hai, jo contextually totally ulta hai.
tip: Negative words ('Tarnishing', 'Damaging') unhi nouns ke sath rakhein jo actual causes hain.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. The global tech giants aggressively expanded their workforce during the pandemic. || II. The companies are now announcing massive layoffs due to an economic slowdown. || Starters: A. Having aggressively expanded their... B. Aggressively expanding their workforce... C. Having been aggressively expanded... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentence: 'Having aggressively expanded their workforce during the pandemic, the global tech giants are now announcing massive layoffs.' Starter B (Aggressively expanding) continuous action dikhata hai, jo illogical hai kyunki expansion pehle hua tha aur layoffs ab ho rahe hain. Starter C passive hai (companies expand nahi hui thi, unhone workforce expand ki thi), toh ye dangling modifier ban jayega.
trick: Ek action poora hone ke baad dusra shuru ho raha hai, isliye 'Having + V3' (Perfect Participle) use hoga, continuous 'V-ing' nahi.
tip: Past completed action ke liye hamesha Perfect Participle (Having + V3) dhundhein.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. The new e-commerce regulations strictly prohibited deep discounting practices. || II. Several online marketplaces had to completely restructure their festive sale models. || Starters: A. Strictly prohibiting deep discounting... B. Restructuring their festive sale... C. Due to the new e-commerce... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Restructuring their festive sale models, several online marketplaces complied with the new regulations.' 2) 'Due to the new e-commerce regulations strictly prohibiting deep discounting, several online marketplaces had to restructure.' Agar hum Starter A use karte hain, toh lagta hai ki online marketplaces khud deep discounting prohibit kar rahi thi, jo logically galat hai (dangling modifier).
trick: Starter A main clause ke subject 'online marketplaces' ke action se match nahi karta. Prohibit sarkar ne kiya hai, marketplaces ne nahi.
tip: Starter wahi valid hai jo sentence ke doer ke action se match kare.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Forced to transfer the burden to passengers, domestic airlines reacted to the surging fuel prices.' 2) 'With the aviation turbine fuel prices surging to an unprecedented high, airlines were forced to transfer the burden.' Starter A ek dangling modifier banata hai kyunki iske baad 'domestic airlines' aayega, jiska matlab nikalta hai ki airlines unprecedented high par surge kar rahi thi.
trick: 'Surging' fuel prices ke liye hai, airlines ke liye nahi. Isliye 'Surging' se sentence start karna airlines ke context mein galat ho jayega.
tip: Modifiers hamesha apne nazdeeki noun ko describe karte hain.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. B. Having systematically diluted the... C. Following the systematic dilution of... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentence: 'Following the systematic dilution of the insolvency and bankruptcy code, the recovery of non-performing assets slowed down drastically.' Starter A aur B dono dangling traps hain. Agar hum inko use karke main subject 'recovery' lagate hain, toh lagta hai 'recovery' ne code ko dilute kiya ya 'recovery' khud dilute ho gayi.
trick: Sentence ka subject 'recovery of non-performing assets' hai. Recovery ne laws dilute nahi kiye hain, isliye active/passive participles eliminate ho jayenge.
tip: Prepositional phrases (Following, After) subject mismatch se bacha lete hain.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. The central government abruptly banned the export of wheat. || II. The domestic wholesale inflation showed immediate signs of cooling down. || Starters: A. Abruptly banning the export... B. Having abruptly banned the... C. Because of the abrupt ban... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentence: 'Because of the abrupt ban on the export of wheat by the central government, the domestic wholesale inflation showed immediate signs of cooling down.' Starters A aur B ka subject 'inflation' ban jayega agar unhe start mein lagaya, matlab inflation ne wheat ban kiya, jo nonsense hai.
trick: Starter A aur B active participles hain. Inke aage government aana chahiye, par second sentence inflation par focused hai, isliye dono options eliminate ho jayenge.
tip: Cause aur effect sentences mein 'Because of' ya 'Due to' best starters hote hain.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. Struggling to monetize the... C. Invested heavily in the... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Having invested heavily in the 5G spectrum auction, the telecom operators are now struggling.' 2) 'Struggling to monetize the upgraded networks effectively, the telecom operators regret having invested heavily.' Starter C galat hai kyunki 'Invested' (V3) passive voice dikhata hai, jabki operators ne khud invest kiya hai (active voice).
trick: Operators ne khud invest kiya hai, toh passive Starter C ('Invested heavily') directly operators ke liye use nahi ho sakta. Active form ('Having invested') sahi hai.
tip: Subject active hai ya passive, ye pehchan kar V3 ya V-ing choose karein.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. Lacking clear financial outlay... B. Remaining skeptical about committing... C. As the ambitious green hydrogen... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Remaining skeptical about committing large-scale capital, private investors waited for clear details.' 2) 'As the ambitious green hydrogen mission lacked clear financial details, private investors remained skeptical.' Starter A dangling trap hai kyunki agar iske baad 'private investors' likhenge, toh matlab hoga ki investors ke paas outlay details nahi thi, jabki mission ke paas nahi thi.
trick: Lacking kiske liye use hua hai? Mission ke liye. Agar Starter A use karenge toh main subject 'investors' ban jayega, jo eliminate karne ka direct hint hai.
tip: Dangling modifier context ko bilkul ulta kar deta hai, isliye logically sochiye.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. The domestic semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem was virtually non-existent. || II. The country heavily relied on imports from neighboring nations. || Starters: A. Being virtually non-existent... B. Heavily relying on imports... C. With the domestic semiconductor... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Heavily relying on imports from neighboring nations, the country suffered due to a non-existent ecosystem.' 2) 'With the domestic semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem being virtually non-existent, the country heavily relied on imports.' Starter A dangling hai kyunki 'country' non-existent nahi thi, 'ecosystem' non-existent tha.
trick: Starter A 'Being' se shuru ho raha hai. Iske baad 'the country' aayega. Kya desh non-existent hai? Nahi. Toh Starter A turant eliminate karein.
tip: 'Being' wale starters generally usi subject ko point karte hain jo turant baad aaye.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. The schools finally reopened for offline physical classes. || II. The prominent EdTech startups witnessed a massive drop in subscriptions. || Starters: A. Witnessing a massive drop... B. Reopening for offline physical... C. Because the schools finally... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Witnessing a massive drop in subscriptions, the prominent EdTech startups struggled as schools reopened.' 2) 'Because the schools finally reopened for offline physical classes, EdTech startups witnessed a drop.' Starter B galat hai kyunki lagta hai ki startups offline classes ke liye reopen ho rahe the.
trick: Starter B 'Reopening' lagane par agla word 'EdTech startups' hoga, jo online hain. Ye clearly common sense aur logic ke khilaf hai.
tip: Subject aur verb ka practical relation sense banana chahiye.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. The ambitious highway construction project was stalled for three years. || II. The local farmers completely refused to hand over their fertile land. || Starters: A. Stalled for three years... B. Refusing to hand over... C. Having stalled the ambitious... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Stalled for three years, the ambitious highway construction project suffered due to the farmers.' 2) 'Refusing to hand over their fertile land, the local farmers stalled the ambitious highway project.' Starter C galat hai kyunki 'Having stalled' farmers ke liye hai, par 'ambitious project' aage likha hai jiska order galat ho jata hai.
trick: Starter C grammatically clumsy hai kyunki active perfect participle ke turant baad object 'project' de diya, jisse farmers ka subject position lost ho gaya.
tip: Participles ke baad hamesha doer (kaam karne wala) aana zaroori hai.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. The global crude oil prices plummeted unexpectedly in the international market. || II. The government completely scrapped the windfall tax on domestic energy firms. || Starters: A. Plummeting unexpectedly in the... B. Scrapping the windfall tax... C. Following the unexpected plummeting... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentences: 1) 'Scrapping the windfall tax on domestic energy firms, the government reacted to the plummeting crude prices.' 2) 'Following the unexpected plummeting of global crude oil prices, the government scrapped the windfall tax.' Starter A galat hai kyunki 'government' plummet (gir) nahi rahi thi, oil prices gir rahe the.
trick: Agar Starter A (Plummeting) use kiya, toh lagta hai government international market mein gir rahi hai. Direct dangling trap hai, eliminate karein.
tip: V-ing modifier wahi noun leta hai jo coma (,) ke turant baad ho.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. The developed nations consistently failed to meet their climate finance pledges. || II. The developing countries demanded a dedicated loss and damage fund. || Starters: A. Consistently failing to meet... B. Demanding a dedicated loss... C. Having been consistently failed... || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Combined sentence: 'Demanding a dedicated loss and damage fund, the developing countries called out the developed nations' failure.' Starter A dangling hai kyunki 'developing countries' ne pledges fail nahi ki thi. Starter C passive hai aur galat meaning de raha hai ki developed nations ko fail kiya gaya.
trick: Starter A fail hone ke baare mein hai, jabki main clause developing countries par based hai. Developing countries fail nahi hui, isliye A reject hoga.
tip: Sentence combine karte waqt original meaning reverse nahi hona chahiye.

question: Direction: Which of the following phrases (A, B, C) can be used as a starter to combine the following sentences into one logically and grammatically correct sentence? || I. The manufacturing sector failed to create adequate blue-collar jobs. || II. The nation's demographic dividend slowly turned into a demographic disaster. || Starters: A. Failing to create adequate... B. Slowly turning into a... C. Because the manufacturing sector... || Question: Select the correct combination.
